title: GPT-5 and o3 model snapshots are removed from the API on December 11
detail: Older GPT-5 and o3 snapshots were given notice of removal from the API. Pinned snapshot IDs do not roll forward to a successor.
impact: If you pinned an older snapshot to keep output stable, the call stops resolving on that date rather than silently upgrading. Budget a migration and an eval pass before December.
